name: High Potency Radioactive Fallout
summary: In Gnomeregan's depths, researchers seek potent radioactive fallout. They hope to learn how the sludge afflicted the leper gnomes and find a cure.

sections.title: Straight from the Tap
sections.body:
Deep in the Hall of Gears, irradiated horrors, lurkers, and slimes roam Gnomeregan's lowest tiers. Researchers outside the fallen capital need fallout drawn from these living creatures. Samples scraped from contaminated scavengers outside are too weak for their work.

The sludge decays quickly. It must be sealed in a leaden phial and reach the researchers before its potency fades.

sections.title: A Search for Restoration
sections.body:
Ozzie Togglevolt and his colleagues seek a cure for the leper gnomes. They believe the secrets of the irradiated sludge may show them the way. During the trogg invasion, toxic venting deformed these survivors and drove them mad.

The leper gnomes remain trapped in a living nightmare. For the researchers, dangerous expeditions into the ruins are worth the risk.

faq.q: Where does this radioactive fallout come from?
faq.answer: The fallout comes from living irradiated creatures deep in the lower tiers of Gnomeregan's Hall of Gears, including slimes, horrors, and lurkers.
Gnomish researchers, including Ozzie Togglevolt, need a concentrated sample of Gnomeregan's radiation to study the affliction and seek a cure for the leper gnomes.

faq.q: Why must it be handled so carefully?
faq.answer: The fallout decays quickly and loses its potency. It must be carried in a leaden phial and returned to the researchers before it degrades.

faq.q: Why wasn't earlier trogg residue good enough?
faq.answer: Residue from troggs outside the city was too weak and impure for testing. Researchers need raw, concentrated fallout from creatures deep within irradiated Gnomeregan.

angles.text: Each sample of toxic fallout from Gnomeregan's depths offers a frail hope of reversing the mutation that tore your kin apart during the city's fall.
Volatile fallout decays quickly, so carry it in purpose-built leaden phials to shield yourself from exposure.
